_doc: FE-C (batch 2: W9-5 base, W9-7 share cards, the walk helper, trip.html server strings) interface strings waiting for their ja (i18n lane). Not part of the catalogue: tools/beta/i18n-fec/merge.py moves them into tools/beta/i18n/en.json together with pending-ja.json in ONE commit (test-i18n requires en and ja to match key for key).

strings.trip.page.title: Trips · Cleo
strings.trip.page.desc: Make a trip of several days from places you saved: one area a day, nearest next, walking estimates, closed places left out with the reason. One link, a printable booklet and KML.
